SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom_counts AS ac
    ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND ac.atom_count = (
      SELECT MAX(ac2.atom_count)
      FROM atom_counts AS ac2
      JOIN molecule AS m2
          ON m2.molecule_id = ac2.molecule_id
      WHERE m2.label = '+'
  )

WITH min_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM min_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT mc.Segment,
           AVG(mc.total_consumption) AS annual_avg
    FROM min_consumption mc
    JOIN min_per_segment mps
      ON mc.Segment = mps.Segment
     AND mc.total_consumption = mps.min_total
    GROUP BY mc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, AVG(t.total_consumption) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_totals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,

SELECT

     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo')
  -
  (SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control)
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye')
  AS difference

SELECT
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.id END)
    -
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END)

    AS ball_control_difference
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control END) -
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control END) AS difference
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye')

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END) AS difference
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

SELECT
    1.0 * SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) / NULLIF(
        COUNT(
            CASE
                WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.id
            END
        ),
        0
    )
    -
    1.0 * SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) / NULLIF(
        COUNT(
            CASE
                WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.id
            END
        ),
        0
    ) AS average_ball_control_difference
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye')

    SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'CZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discount_station_difference
FROM gasstations
WHERE Segment = 'Discount'
  AND Country IN ('CZE', 'SVK')
SELECT AVG(L.PT) FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.PT < 14

SELECT CASE
         WHEN instr(GSoffered, '-') > 0 THEN substr(GSoffered, 1, instr(GSoffered, '-') - 1)
         ELSE GSoffered
       END AS lowest_grade
FROM schools
WHERE NCESDist = '0613360'
  AND EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'

SELECT AVG(l.PT) AS average_prothrombin_time
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.PT < 14

SELECT AVG(Consumption) / 12 AS AverageMonthlyConsumption
FROM yearmonth
JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE customers.Segment = 'SME'
  AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

SELECT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY t.ProductID, p.Description
ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT name FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'borderless' AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'CZE' AND Segment = 'Discount') -
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'SVK' AND Segment = 'Discount') AS more_discount_stations

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'borderless'
  AND (cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL OR cardKingdomId IS NULL)
ORDER BY name

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.year = 2010
AND c.country NOT IN (
    'Malaysia', 'Bahrain', 'China', 'Singapore', 'Japan', 'Korea', 'India', 'UAE', 'Turkey', 'Saudi Arabia', 'Qatar',
